question_text: Question linked to image nº5 A 25-year-old woman with palpable and painless adenopathy in the supraclavicular region. The patient reports that she has had febrile periods.         ### Question
        Question linked to image nº5 A 25-year-old woman with palpable and painless adenopathy in the supraclavicular region. The patient reports that she has had febrile periods.
